Ici cikabweseshamo:
- Ifyalo ne fipimo fya fishinka

- Amakonfigurashi ya cibombelo ne fipimo

onboardingStepSetup:
SETUP
109 Foni yenu nomba ni cibombelo ca Minecraft
onboardingWelcomeTitle: Your phone is now\na Minecraft server
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Ukupokelela amaseva ya Java ayabula ukulipilisha.
Takuli PC iyakabilwa. Ukubelenga no muntu onse.
onboardingStep1Body: Paper runs locally on your phone and uses the memory you already have.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft gives you a unique relay address that friends can connect to.
onboardingStep3Body: Java Edition players connect straight through the relay with minimal friction.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Bring your world, plugins, and config with you. Takuli ukutendeka cipya cipya.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Export from Aternos, drop the archive in PocketCraft, and keep going.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Reuse the same .jar files. Your plugin stack moves with you.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, and operator access remain intact.
onboardingFeaturesTitle: Full control, right in your pocket
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Not a stripped-down app. Ici ecibombelo ca cine cine ica server.
onboardingFeaturesBanner: Everything you need in one place
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft supports Java and Bedrock cross-play when the bridge is enabled in your server setup.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Friends on PC and mobile can join the same world together through the relay.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Share your server address and players can connect from their own edition right away.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Experimental Feature - Play at Your Own Discretion

Cross-play is still in active development. Bugs and stability issues may occur as this feature is not yet officially supported. Ukubomfya pa mulandu wenu.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Pick the relay server closest to your players. You can change this later from the dashboard too.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: Ici cibomfiwa ku mibele ya cibombelo, ukupenda kwa basambi, na ifishinka fyacindama ifya ku numa ilyo icibombelo cenu cilebomba.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Shows server status and player count while the server is running.
onboardingPermissionsStatusSet: Mwe bonse mwaipekanya. Tinikeni pa Kukonkapo pa kuti mutwalilile.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: Ukufika ku kwishibisha kulafwaikwa pali iyi nshita. Tinikeni pe batani ili pa muulu, lyene mulesuminisha mu Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Tinikeni pa batani lya pa muulu, lyena suminisheni ukusuminisha kwa Android ukwa kwisula Icakonkapo.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Ingila nomba pakuti wingasuminisha ukusunga kwa Google ukwa pa lwakwe. Kuti wacilapo pali ici no kupwisha ukupanga intanshi.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: Backups are stored inside your private Google Drive app folder. PC_APP_ISHINA tekuti limone nangu ukufika ku mafayilo yenu ayambi aya Drive.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: Your server worlds, plugins, and settings will automatically backup to: %s
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: Kuti mwabweseshamo ifya kusunga ifya calo pa numa mu Fibikilo ilyo fye mwaiteyanya.
